content.short: Wildchain is a non-profit that uses tools to gamify conservation.
content.description: Wildchain is a play-to-impact game that enables digital adoption of endangered animals while directing support to conservation through a grant program and a governance DAO. By turning play into real-world funding, it helps address the fundraising gap faced by grassroots conservation charities, with donations flowing directly as players engage. Designed for daily use on a smartphone, the app invites a caring, active community to join a shared movement for tangible conservation outcomes.
